rationale: Twenty character profiles, not twenty unique engines. Russian uses three GA neural timbres, including one male engine. English uses four GA British English timbres. Conservative rate/pitch distinctions preserve intelligibility; they cannot create genuinely separate actors or reliable age/texture.
pronunciation_note: Proposed fictional-name stress: Mara, TO-man, E-lin, RA-ut, RA-dek, BE-ran, i-VE-ta. Human review must approve these choices; display text is never accented or rewritten.

mara.note: Grounded female innkeeper and convoy owner; low, practical, unshowy authority.

toman.note: Weathered male miller/witness; measured and reluctant, not a theatrical ghost voice.

lida.note: Mature female orchard keeper; firm, warm, matter-of-fact grief.

yara.note: Female hunt warden; brisk, clear authority.

ivet.note: Female nurse; quiet steadiness without whispered consonants.

oss.note: Male ferryman; work-worn, hesitant when admitting responsibility.

orsa.note: Female grain factor; deliberate and precise.

dren.note: Male salvage leader; blunt and guarded.

hana.note: Female signal keeper; focused technical clarity.

beran.note: Male glass founder; restrained bass register, patient technical speech.

tessa.note: Female healer; energetic precision, no supernatural affect.

vesk.note: Male auditor; contained and exact, slightly quicker than Elin.

radek.note: Older male bell founder; spacious, grounded craft authority.

nika.note: Female mountain guide; firm, brisk instructions.

lev.note: Older male steward; calm hospitable rhythm.

ada.note: Older female burial keeper; gently weathered, deliberate rather than frail.

mila.note: Younger adult female seamstress; light and direct, not a child voice.

elin.note: Male scholar; quiet measured resolve, no villain or spectral processing.

ren.note: Male wheelwright; practical dry humor and a quicker rhythm.

player.note: Adult male captain, consistent with Russian authored first-person gender; direct neutral choices.

narrator.note: Neutral male evidence/epilogue narrator; clear, unhurried, no dramatic whisper.
